body: Lead spec of a 2-layer sequenced program (author choice 2026-06-15): sibling-context FIRST, hierarchical head SECOND, each shipped as a gated PATCH (NOT 0.7.0). Probe-first (ac-01 gate) because efficacy on our boundaries is unproven — coordinates strong prior, currency uncertain. Builds on the abandoned 2026-03-24-sibling-context-multi-branch (closed 0/7, stranded at integration). See memory sibling-context-is-the-stranded-architecture-layer.

ac-01 GO (gate cleared): sibling-context separates coordinates at AUC 0.956 vs 0.716 value-only (+0.24) — a latitude col almost always has a longitude-NAMED sibling (95-96% vs 2% for decimals). SCOPE CORRECTION: currency is header-decisive (own-header AUC 0.964) not sibling-decisive (0.655) — dropped from this spec, stays with the currency/training path. Lead target for ac-02 build = coordinates + other sibling-paired types. Signal is sibling HEADER embeddings, not value ranges. See ac01_efficacy_probe.md.
